name: Jean Silva

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (67 in height, 69 in reach, orthodox, featherweight). Recent fights: beat Arnold Allen by unanimous decision at UFC 324 (2026-01-24); submitted Jose Miguel Delgado (rear-naked choke, R3 2:57) in the Noche UFC 4 main event, Glendale, 2026-09-12 (AgentMMA, Boxing News).

photo_coverage: Good. Front: ESPN studio headshot (older buzz) plus Jan and Sep 2026 press-conference fronts (shaved head). Three-quarter: Sep 2026 fight week, Jan 2026 presser. Profile: Jan 2026 face-off (left side). Physique: two ESPN cutouts and three 2026 weigh-ins. Free-licence: two public-domain White House photos from UFC 314 (April 2025), both red-lit and small in frame, useful for kit and posture only; the Commons face crop did not download (HTTP 429).

face.shape: Squarish oval: broad forehead and temples, strong cheekbones, jaw hidden by the beard. With the shaved head the skull reads wide at the temples with a high, rounded crown.
face.jaw: Medium-wide (under the beard); the beard squares the lower face.
face.chin: Medium, under the beard; the beard ends in a rounded point below the chin.
face.cheekbones: Prominent and fairly wide, with a little hollow beneath at fight weight; deep smile creases when he laughs.
face.forehead: Broad and high, smooth, continuing into the shaved scalp; faint horizontal lines.

eyes.shape: Almond, slightly narrow, heavy upper lids; crinkle to slits with crow's feet when he smiles.
eyes.size: Medium, deep-set, with mild under-eye bags.

eyebrows.shape: Low and straight with a slight arch toward the outer third; slightly heavier at the inner ends.

nose.width: Medium bridge, base a little broad.
nose.tip: Rounded, slightly broad and shiny, level.

face.mouth_lips: Medium-wide mouth with a medium upper lip and fuller lower lip, mostly framed by the moustache; very broad open smile showing upper and lower teeth.

ears.protrusion: Moderately out from the head; obvious on the shaved head.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, moderate on both ears: thick, rolled, lumpy upper rims (ESPN headshot; his right ear in the Sep 2026 presser; his left ear in the Jan 2026 face-off).

face.notable_marks_scars: A pale vertical scar at the hairline above his left temple (ESPN headshot); a small dark mole on his left cheek beside the nose. Red marks on the forehead in Jan 2026 and a black left eye in Sep 2026 were fresh fight damage.

hair.style: 2026: head shaved smooth (Jan and Sep 2026 photos, UFC 314 in April 2025). Older studio cutouts show a very short buzz with a high front hairline, deep temple recession and thin coverage on top.
hair.colour: No visible hair on the scalp in 2026 (scalp is skin tone, #ad6f51 to #e3b299 depending on light). When grown, dark brown.
hair.hairline: Not visible in 2026 because the head is shaved.
hair.texture: Unknown when grown beyond a buzz.

facial_hair.colour: Dark brown with auburn/red-brown tones in light, a few lighter hairs on the chin.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the moustache, chin and jaw; the cheek line is natural and a little patchy on the upper cheeks.
facial_hair.shape: Full beard about 1.5-2.5 cm, slightly longer at the chin where it comes to a rounded point; full moustache joined to the beard. Similar length in Jan and Sep 2026 (a little longer in Jan).

skin.tone_note: Each sample is the median of a box on lit skin (box in source pixels); the forehead highlight in the studio headshot is left out of the used average. The White House UFC 314 photos are under red stage light and are not sampled.
skin.undertone: Warm golden-olive; the shaved scalp is a touch darker and redder than the forehead.
skin.freckles_marks: Mole on the left cheek; moderate body hair on the forearms, legs and lower abdomen (a line of hair below the navel).

body.build: Compact, muscular featherweight at 170 cm with a 175 cm reach; dense and athletic rather than lanky.
body.body_fat_notes: Visible six-pack and oblique lines at weigh-ins and in both studio cutouts.
body.chest: Well-developed pecs for his size, flat lower line.
body.legs_calves: Muscular thighs and solid calves; hairy legs.
body.posture: Upright and animated; at weigh-ins he spreads his arms wide and leans in. Hands on knees between rounds at UFC 314.
body.notable_physique_traits: Shaved head with a full brown beard, 'LORD' across the lower chest, padlock on the left chest, full left sleeve; right arm mostly bare except the forearm script.

tattoos.where: Left upper chest below the collarbone, running onto the left shoulder
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey padlock with an ornate quatrefoil (four-lobed) design on its face, linked to shaded clouds that trail over the left shoulder.
tattoos.size: Padlock about 10 cm tall; clouds to the deltoid

tattoos.description: Full black-and-grey sleeve: clouds, sun rays, a small cross, a large spread-winged bird or angel on the upper arm, a pocket watch or compass on the forearm, stars, and a date ending '.12.96' near the inner elbow (matches his 27 Dec 1996 birthday).

tattoos.where: Lower chest, across both sides just below the pecs
tattoos.description: 'LORD' in large black serif capitals with a drop shadow.
tattoos.size: About 25 cm wide x 7 cm tall

tattoos.where: Right thigh, front, just below the shorts hem
Inner right forearm (small script, not a sleeve)
tattoos.description: Cursive 'Familia' with a small heart loop (Sep 2026 photo).

accessories_seen: Gold chain with a round gold medallion (Sep 2026), gold chain and pendant (Jan 2026), gold wristwatch; often wears glasses or sunglasses at media events (clear dark frames, amber lenses, white wraparounds).

kit.typical_shorts: Studio cutouts: black UFC shorts with a grey chevron-wave pattern, white-check waistband, crypto.com and Noche UFC patches (newer); green shorts with gold 'SILVA' lettering, a gold geometric side panel and a green-white-red waistband stripe (older). UFC 314 (Apr 2025): yellow shorts with a dark pattern and black waistband, blue corner tape.
kit.brand_note: Logos visible: UFC, crypto.com, Noche UFC patch (newer), Venum (older).

stance_and_guard.seen_in_photos: Only a between-rounds style frame at UFC 314 (bent forward, hands on knees). No guard photo, so nothing about his guard is inferred.

render_hints.skin_base: mh-skin-young_caucasian_male (closest swatch) tinted toward the sampled tone
render_hints.hair: none: smooth shaved scalp, skin-tone, slightly redder at the crown; no hairline
render_hints.beard: full beard about 18 mm, #3e271c with auburn highlights, rounded point at the chin
render_hints.tattoos: left sleeve, padlock on the left chest, 'LORD' across the lower chest; the right-forearm 'Familia' is a small script, do not render it as a sleeve

morphs_extra._note: Targets from assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz (read by src/avatar3d.js). l- = the fighter's own left. Moderate cauliflower on both ears (thicker, slightly protruding), wide temples on the shaved skull.

notes: Confidence: high for the shaved head, beard, tattoos, skin and build; medium-high for the face (three fronts, two three-quarters, one profile with glasses); medium for morphs. What to watch: (1) smooth shaved head in 2026 with a high rounded crown, not the old buzz; (2) full dark-brown beard with auburn tones and a rounded chin point; (3) deep-set dark eyes under a strong, low brow; big laugh with crow's feet; (4) thick cauliflower ears on both sides; (5) mole on the left cheek and a pale scar above the left temple; (6) 'LORD' across the lower chest, padlock on the left chest, full left sleeve, flowers on the right thigh; (7) compact 170 cm, muscular and lean. Ignore the Day-of-the-Dead face paint (Sep 2026 ceremonial) and fresh fight marks. ageOldM uses (years-25)/65 like src/avatar3d.js.
